title: Temporary reading-collection offers
provenance: Fictional offers; not live or independently verified.
scope: 2 Nov 2026 offers / same 60 named books, same school / EUR
intent: Help the school librarian inspect these written offers: quoted loan, readiness wording, carriage and renewal terms, not choose or book. Both offers cover the same 60 named books delivered to the same school. Source order is not ranking. No final all-in total is established; conditional renewal or carriage is not established as secured. Do not convert working days to calendar days or infer pupil availability on a quoted ready date.

criteria.name: Quoted loan
criteria.question: What loan charge and period are quoted?

criteria.name: Readiness wording
criteria.question: What does the offer say about readiness, and what does that establish?

criteria.name: Return carriage
criteria.question: Is return carriage offered, at what charge and under what conditions?

criteria.name: Renewal
criteria.question: Is renewal permitted, with what limits and charge?

criteria.name: Other terms
criteria.question: What lost-book charges, late fees and weekend contact arrangements are supplied?
